children._comment: r4wiki-0820: the disclosure is wrapped in `padding`, NOT a bare `column`. The engine's root fill-column path (renderer.dart `_rootFillColumn` / `_fillChromeTypes`) only fills the notepad when every OTHER top-level child of the screen's root column is a cheap chrome type — text/divider/spacer/button/row/padding. `column` is not in that set, so a bare column here silently drops the whole reader onto the page-scroll path and the notepad's Expanded lands under an unbounded height (caught red by wikipick_reader_scroll_test.dart's 900x460 case). Keep this wrapper a chrome type.

children._comment: wikiparity-0820wp2 (tester finding #2): compact BOTTOM icon action bar, replacing the old top text-link row. Placed as the LAST child of the root column (same 'cheap chrome type' rule as the padding-wrapped disclosure above) so the notepad above still gets Expanded fill — this bar renders pinned below the article, not part of its scroll. Save/Saved, Language (cheap fallback: opens the real Wikipedia page, where its own language switcher lives — no interlanguage-links fetch added), Find, Contents and Open-on-Wikipedia are always-reachable; Remove/Cache-links/Donate stay in the existing Reading-options disclosure, now reached via this bar's own toggle (same action/label as before, just relocated) — that disclosure IS the overflow.
